title: Tappan Golf Center
specs: Go-karts reach speeds up to 20 mph
Mini golf course is 18 holes with multiple elevations, water hazards, and challenging layout
Driving range has 100 heated and weather-protected hitting bays with cooling fans
Single kart drivers must be at least 10 years old and 54 inches tall
Double kart drivers must be at least 18 years old; passengers at least 36 inches tall; no two adults in double kart
Guests with certain health conditions (back, neck, spinal injuries, seizures, heart conditions, pregnancy) should refrain from go-karting
Private party room for up to 25 kids available for $100 for two hours; additional time $60 per hour
Group discounts for 10 or more participants on mini golf, go karts, batting cages

blurb: Guests can enjoy mini golf, go karts, batting cages, private golf bays, and a large driving range with heated bays and Toptracer technology. The center offers customizable party packages for birthdays, family gatherings, school trips, and corporate outings. Food delivery and private party rooms are available for events.
